items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: Ramsey's interview was published in Downbeat.

ctx.x: Yeah. For some reason, they called them bootleggers. It means that they were pirated. One of the labels is called Jolly Roger. And incidentally, Victor would press those things for those guys. They'd steal the Victor rights, you might say. They didn't steal anything directly because it wasn't the actual property. But they'd take the records off, copy them, and issue them on another record.
